_comment: Versions of the customer-facing agreements that a buyer accepts at checkout. api/checkout.js shows these documents on the order-confirmation step and writes their versions into the acceptance record and the Stripe session metadata, so every order can later prove which text was accepted. Bump a version here in the same change that edits the page; tests/acceptance.test.mjs fails if a page's own 'Last updated' / 'Effective' line no longer matches. 'certification' is shown only when Continuous Certification sales are switched on (CERTIFICATION_SALES_ENABLED=1, off by default) and the buyer ticks the separate opt-in; its version is recorded with that opt-in.

certification.title: Continuous Certification: what it covers
certification.status: awaiting counsel review; certification sales stay off until approved
